content_zh:
许安安看她这般凄惨狼狈，同情的拍了拍她的脸颊。“走吧走吧，晚上我请客。”

白薇秀抬起头，水汪汪的大眼闪着感动。“安安，我就知道你对我最好了，没关系，我知道你跟你的Lover约好了，我可不想变成超级电灯泡，况且我的事情还没做完，呜呜，你去吧。”说完，她极为不舍的松开手，但依旧泪眼汪汪。

许安安忍不住失笑。她这不是摆明了在使苦肉计吗？“今天是星期五，你别这么委屈，我跟洪伟说一声就行了，他不会介意的，我让他招待你今晚全部的吃食跟酒，完全免费喔！”洪伟是许安安的Lover，是信义区一家颇具知名PUB的老板。

当白薇秀听到完全免费四个字时，眼睛瞬间大亮，而且她真的压力大到都快要拔头发了，不好好大醉一场真的很难抒发。

白薇秀从大学时期就有这样的习惯，只要压力一大，她就会去喝酒，让自己彻彻底底烂醉一场，隔日醒来什么烦恼都忘了，什么也不怕了，又能够继续往前冲，而许安安就是那个每次都要陪她的倒霉人。

话说回来，许安安现在的Lover洪伟，就是她有一次又靠喝酒发泄时，许安安陪她去PUB所认识的，算来她也算是他们的小红娘，他们是该感恩图报。

“走啦，还犹豫什么，洪伟店里的招牌炸辣鸡翅不是你最喜欢吃的吗？我叫厨房帮你准备整整一大盘，好不好？”

用美食诱惑，没吃晚餐的白薇秀完全招架不住。

距离赵霖跟颜芳菲的世纪婚礼还有两个礼拜，她只要再熬过两个礼拜就行了，今晚她需要大喝一场，累积未来两个礼拜的能量！

白薇秀拽起包包，锁好店门，便拉着许安安，冲了。

喔喔，这一切实在太美好了。

喝到饱的调酒、整整一大盘的炸辣鸡翅、知名S所播放的音乐，还有价值百万的音响跟灯光设备，白薇秀坐在吧台靠里面的角落，肆意享受着。

她有个怪癖，一般人舒压都会选择安静的场所，她却喜欢待在热闹吵杂的地方喝酒，看形形色色的人来来去去，还有人生百态。

许安安在她坚持下，跟洪伟不知道跑到哪儿卿卿我我去了，洪伟离开前还特地交代酒保要看好她，任何前来搭讪的男人都必须轰走，必要时请出PUB保镖也行，所以她可以很安心的喝她的酒、吃她的辣鸡翅，本来堆积如山的压力顿时减缓了下来。

只是来PUB里喝酒跳舞作乐的红男绿女，个个的眼睛可是都很闪亮的，尤其那些自认猎艳高手的男人，环顾PUB一圈，即刻锁定几个长得还不错，身材也够辣的女人，摩拳擦掌，蠢蠢欲动。

白薇秀不是来这里寻求刺激的，穿的依旧是制服，可还是将她姣好的身材表露无遗。

爱猎艳的男人就是贱，在PUB里看惯穿着暴露，胸部绝对只包起来二分之一，短裙短到好像布料很贵买不起似的女人，那种气质美好，不经意表露出OL气息的女人，更能吸引他们的注意。

白薇秀不只被一个男人锁定，从她入座半个小时后，陆陆续续就有三个自以为帅气的男人上前来想要搭讪，可是他们都还没来得及开口，要不就是才刚说了声Hi，就被身材很猛男的酒保给瞪了回去，要他们快滚。

她乐得轻松，挥挥手要猛男酒保再给一杯酒，她的酒量可是从大学时期就开始训练，不敢说海量啦，不过也差不多了。

第2章(2)

PUB的另一个角落，当赵霖看白薇秀喝下第N杯调酒后，他向来冷静的脸庞终于松动了，露出不可置信的神情。

那个女人还真会喝！

他大概是九点钟从公司离开，直接来到跟好友吴德亮相约的这间PUB，来的时候吴德亮已经到了，怎知两人聊不到几句，吴德亮的手机响起，结束通话后，他表示队上有急务急Call.

吴德亮和他是国小同学，长相很普通，算是其貌不扬，脑袋却很灵活，后来他考上警大，毕业后运气颇佳，破了好几个大案子，年纪轻轻就已经是刑警大队的大队长，官运好到让人嫉妒。

不过他忙碌的程度也随着位置爬越高而越见不到人影，今天好不容易两人终于碰面了，却聊不到五分钟他就得离开。

吴德亮跟赵霖说抱歉，赵霖拍拍他的肩，表示明白，下次再约。

吴德亮离开后，赵霖独自坐了一会儿，本想着把杯中的酒喝完就要离开，却没想到竟意外看见白薇秀。

隔着喧哗热闹的舞池，他静静观察着她，想起早上那通电话的对谈，他情不自禁嘴角微弯，笑了。

距离婚礼还有两个礼拜，以他婚礼的规格，想来必是“一生一世”接过最盛大的一场，他以为她现在应该忙得不可开交，怎么还有闲情逸致在这里喝酒？

赵霖本来是这样的想法，觉得白薇秀肯定是还不够忙，可是当他发现她把酒当水喝时，这才惊觉，她这不是闲情逸致在喝酒，而是在发泄似的猛灌。

他皱起眉头，脑袋闪过一丝念头，脚挪动了一下却又止住不动。以他跟她的交情，呃，他们似乎没有什么交情可言，他要是前去规劝她少喝一点，搞不好她还会嫌他多事。

或许他的行为跟笑脸会让很多人误会他是个心善之人，但只有他自己知道，友善的形象是他刻意塑造的，真正的他，可以冷眼看着人们在他面前出糗丢脸或是被伤害，他的眉头也不会多皱一下。

赵霖的心，主动把白薇秀列入跟自己不相干的范围内。

喝完了酒，他是该走人了，回公司继续加班或窝回独居的豪宅里看老影片，都比待在这充满烟味、酒味还有低俗香水味的地方来得好。

可是不知怎地，他迟迟没有移动脚步，然后他发现，不只他在盯着白薇秀看，PUB里还有很多男人也正盯着她，宛若恶狼盯着一块上好的肥肉。

穿着合身制服的白薇秀，没有刻意的浓妆黯抹跟摆弄性感做作的姿态，她喝酒跟啃鸡翅的模样是多么的豪迈跟自然，当然，她完美的身材比例才是那些恶狼最觊觎的。

从他的角度望过去，那高耸的胸部随着她手部的抬动上上下下，纤细的柳腰跟丰盈的臀是绝妙又性感的组合，在短裙之下修长的美腿在高脚椅下微微交迭，只要是男人，真的会挪不开视线，像他就是。

赵霖在此时也发现，已经有几个男人忍不住扑了上去，却都被吧台内身材媲美健身先生的猛男酒保给怒挡了回去。

很显然，白薇秀跟那名猛男酒保是认识的，偶尔有空档时，酒保也会跟她聊个几句，但似乎不在意她豪迈的喝酒方式，还不停将调好的酒往她面前送。

赵霖不知道的是，猛男酒保可是见识过白薇秀那可跟大海媲美的酒量，更何况老板有交代，她要喝多少给她喝就对了，喝越多她的压力越少，如果她真的喝到挂了，先把她扛到后头他的私人办公室，等许安安跟他幽会回来，许安安会带她回家的。

白薇秀也很清楚，有许安安跟洪伟，还有猛男酒保在，她是很安全的，那些前来搭讪不怀好意的男人，统统都会被击退……只有一个男人除外。

赵霖终究没忍住，他曾几何时变得如此鸡婆，他自己也不解，寻了个白薇秀身旁座位的空档，无视于猛男酒保杀死人的目光，坦白说，他一点都不怕那个猛男酒保，他是光有一身肌肉好看，若真要贴身肉搏的话，他十拳内就会让他倒地。
content_en:
Seeing how miserable and embarrassed she was, Xu Anan patted her cheek sympathetically."Come on, let's go, I'll treat you tonight."

Bai Weixiu raised her head, her big watery eyes shining with emotion."An'an, I know you are the best to me. It doesn't matter. I know you have made an appointment with your Lover. I don't want to become a super light bulb. Besides, my work is not finished yet. Wuwu, you go ahead." After saying that, she let go of her hand with great reluctance, but her eyes were still full of tears.

Xu Anan couldn't help laughing.Isn't it obvious that she is trying to make someone suffer?"Today is Friday, don't be so aggrieved. I just need to tell Hong Wei. He won't mind. I'll let him treat you to all the food and wine tonight. It's completely free!" Hong Wei is Xu An'an's Lover and the owner of a well-known PUB in Xinyi District.

When Bai Weixiu heard the words "completely free", her eyes suddenly lit up, and she was so stressed that she almost pulled out her hair. It was really difficult to express herself without getting drunk.

Bai Weixiu has had this habit since college. Whenever she is under great pressure, she will drink and get completely drunk. When she wakes up the next day, she has forgotten all her worries, is not afraid of anything, and can continue to move forward. And Xu Anan is the unlucky person who has to accompany her every time.

Speaking of which, Xu Anan's current lover, Hong Wei, was the one she met when Xu Anan accompanied her to a PUB when she was drinking to let off steam. She can be considered their little matchmaker, and they should be grateful in return.

"Let's go, why are you hesitating? Isn't Hong Wei's signature fried spicy chicken wings your favorite? I'll ask the kitchen to prepare a big plate for you, okay?"

Bai Weixiu, who had not eaten dinner, was tempted by delicious food and couldn't resist it.

There are still two weeks until Zhao Lin and Yan Fangfei's wedding of the century. She only needs to survive another two weeks. She needs to have a big drink tonight to accumulate energy for the next two weeks!

Bai Weixiu grabbed her bag, locked the store door, and rushed out with Xu Anan.

Oh wow, this is so wonderful.

Bai Weixiu sat in the inner corner of the bar and enjoyed all-you-can-drink cocktails, a large plate of fried spicy chicken wings, music played by the famous S, and millions of dollars worth of sound and lighting equipment.

She has a quirk. Most people would choose quiet places to relieve stress, but she likes to stay in noisy places to drink and watch all kinds of people coming and going, as well as all kinds of life.

At her insistence, Xu Anan and Hong Wei ran off to have sex with each other somewhere. Before Hong Wei left, he specifically told the bartender to keep an eye on her. Any man who came to chat with her must be chased away. PUB bodyguards could be hired if necessary, so she could drink her wine and eat her spicy chicken wings with peace of mind. The mountain of pressure suddenly eased.

The men and women who just come to the PUB to drink, dance and have fun all have shining eyes, especially those men who consider themselves to be masters of beauty hunting. Looking around the PUB, they immediately locate a few women who are pretty good-looking and have hot bodies. They are gearing up and ready to make a move.

Bai Weixiu didn't come here to seek excitement. She was still wearing a uniform, but she still showed off her beautiful figure.

Men who love to chase women are cheap. In PUB, they are used to seeing women in scantily clad clothes. Their breasts are definitely only covered by half, and their skirts are so short that they look like the fabric is too expensive to buy. Women with a beautiful temperament and inadvertently showing off their OL vibe are more likely to attract their attention.

Bai Weixiu was not only targeted by one man. Half an hour after she took her seat, three men who thought they were handsome came forward one after another and wanted to strike up a conversation. However, before they had time to speak, or as soon as they said Hi, the bartender with a very muscular figure stared back and told them to get out.

She was so happy and relaxed that she waved her hand and asked the macho bartender to give her another drink. She had been practicing her drinking ability since college, so I can't say it was a huge amount, but it was about the same.

Chapter 2(2)

In another corner of the PUB, when Zhao Lin watched Bai Weixiu drink the Nth cup of cocktail, his usually calm face finally relaxed, revealing an expression of disbelief.

That woman really knows how to drink!

He left the company at about nine o'clock and went directly to the PUB where he had an appointment with his friend Wu Deliang. When he came, Wu Deliang had already arrived. Unexpectedly, the two of them could not chat for a few words. Wu Deliang's cell phone rang. After ending the call, he said that there was an urgent call from the team.

Wu Deliang and he were elementary school classmates. He had a very ordinary appearance, but his appearance was not impressive, but his brain was very flexible. Later he was admitted to the police academy. After graduation, he had good luck and solved several major cases. He was already the captain of the criminal police brigade at a young age, and his official luck was so good that it made people jealous.

However, the busier he became, the higher he climbed, the less people he saw. Today, they finally met, but he had to leave after less than five minutes of chatting.

Wu Deliang said sorry to Zhao Lin, and Zhao Lin patted him on the shoulder to express his understanding and make an appointment next time.

After Wu Deliang left, Zhao Lin sat alone for a while, thinking about finishing the wine in his glass and leaving, but he unexpectedly saw Bai Weixiu.

Across the noisy and lively dance floor, he quietly observed her. Thinking of the conversation on the phone in the morning, he couldn't help but curl his lips slightly and smile.

There were still two weeks before the wedding. Based on the size of his wedding, it must be the grandest one in his "lifetime". He thought that she should be very busy now, so how could she still have the leisure to drink here?

Zhao Lin originally thought that Bai Weixiu must not be busy enough, but when he found that she drank the wine as water, he was shocked to realize that she was not drinking leisurely, but drinking heavily as if to vent her anger.

He frowned, a thought flashed through his head, and his feet moved but stopped.Judging from his friendship with her, well, they seemed to have no friendship at all. If he went to persuade her to drink less, she might think he was nosy.

Perhaps his behavior and smiling face will make many people misunderstand that he is a kind-hearted person, but only he knows that the friendly image is deliberately created by him. The real him can watch people being embarrassed or hurt in front of him without frowning more.

Zhao Lin's heart took the initiative to include Bai Weixiu as having nothing to do with him.

After drinking, it was time for him to leave. It would be better to go back to the company and continue working overtime or go back to the mansion where he lived alone and watch old movies than to stay in a place full of smoke, alcohol and vulgar perfume.

But for some reason, he didn't move for a long time, and then he discovered that not only was he staring at Bai Weixiu, but there were many men in the PUB who were also staring at her, like evil wolves staring at a piece of good fat.

Bai Weixiu, who was wearing a well-fitting uniform, did not wear heavy makeup or pose in sexy poses. She looked so bold and natural when drinking and eating chicken wings. Of course, her perfect body proportions were what those evil wolves coveted the most.

Looking from his angle, the towering breasts moved up and down with the movement of her hands. The slender waist and plump hips were a wonderful and sexy combination. The slender legs under the short skirt overlapped slightly under the high chair. As long as it was a man, he would really be unable to take his eyes away, just like him.

At this time, Zhao Lin also discovered that several men could not help but pounce on him, but they were all angrily blocked by the hunky bartender at the bar who had a figure comparable to that of a bodybuilder.

It was obvious that Bai Weixiu and the macho bartender knew each other. Occasionally, the bartender would chat with her when he had free time, but he didn't seem to care about her bold drinking style and kept delivering the mixed drinks in front of her.

What Zhao Lin didn't know was that the macho bartender had seen Bai Weixiu's drinking capacity comparable to Dahai, not to mention that the boss had told her to drink as much as she wanted. The more she drank, the less pressure she would feel. If she really drank until she died, he would first carry her to his private office. When Xu Anan came back from her tryst with him, Xu Anan would take her home.

Bai Weixiu also knew very well that with Xu Anan, Hong Wei, and the macho bartender here, she was very safe. All those men who came to chat with her with ill intentions would be repelled...except for one man.

Zhao Lin couldn't hold it back after all. He had become such a bitch at one time, and he didn't understand it himself. He found a gap in the seat next to Bai Weixiu, ignoring the murderous gaze of the macho bartender. Frankly speaking, he was not afraid of the macho bartender at all. He only had good-looking muscles. If he really wanted to fight hand-to-hand, he would knock him down within ten punches.
